answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 16396 Country: United Kingdom Title: ASALMUALIKUM, 1.Can women read namaz-e-janazah (Funeral prayer)? 2.What if a husband drinks his wife's milk? Is it allowed or not? JAZAKALLH Question: ASALMUALIKUM, 1.Can women read namaz-e-janazah (Funeral prayer)? 2.What if a husband drinks his wife's milk? Is it allowed or not? JAZAKALLH Answer ID: 16396 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1541/1543/M=1430) If only women perform janazah salah, it is not makrooh, they can offer it. But if they attend the salah with men it is makrooh: واعلم أن جماعتھن لا تکرہ في صلاۃ الجنازۃ (الشامي) ویکرہ حضورھن الجماعۃ (الدر المختار ) It is unlawful and haram for husband to drink the milk of wife. But in case one drinks, it will not have an adverse effect on nikah, it will remain intact. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
